#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        if (n >= 100) {
            out << 0 << endl;
            return;
        }

        vector<vector<int>> v(5, vector<int>(105));
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            v[0][i] = in.nextInt();
            v[1][i] = in.nextInt();
            v[2][i] = in.nextInt();
            v[3][i] = in.nextInt();
            v[4][i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        vector<bool> bad(105, false);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (i == j || j == k || k == i) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    long long ax = v[0][j] - v[0][i];
                    long long bx = v[1][j] - v[1][i];
                    long long cx = v[2][j] - v[2][i];
                    long long dx = v[3][j] - v[3][i];
                    long long ex = v[4][j] - v[4][i];

                    long long ay = v[0][k] - v[0][i];
                    long long by = v[1][k] - v[1][i];
                    long long cy = v[2][k] - v[2][i];
                    long long dy = v[3][k] - v[3][i];
                    long long ey = v[4][k] - v[4][i];

                    double val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey;
                    long long m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex;
                    long long m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey;
                    val = val / sqrt(m1);
                    val = val / sqrt(m2);

                    if (acos(val) * (180.0 / M_PI) + 0.000000001 < 90) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad[i]) cnt++;
        }

        out << cnt << endl;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad[i]) out << i << endl;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
